description: Amplifies a safe, bland or generic design into a more distinctive one: stronger type scale and weight contrast, a dominant bold color, a clear focal point and more confident hierarchy, without AI-slop gradients or glassmorphism. Use when the user says the design looks boring, too safe, generic, lacks personality or needs more visual impact. Not for calming a loud design (use ui-quieter).
